notes.title: Announce Trailer & Steam Page Now Live
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello, comrades![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re Rodrigo & Eduardo from Deep Green Games, and after months of enduring BOT.VINNIK’s relentless sarcasm and zero patience, we’re proud to announce: [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in training—but very soon, a [b]free demo[/b] will be available. You’ll get to explore the academy, tackle a few clever puzzles, and experience our grumpy coach's unique teaching style firsthand.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is [i]vital[/i] (before BOT.VINNIK declares humanity a lost cause). Feel free to share your thoughts anytime![/p][p][/p][p]Also: have you seen our [b]Reveal Trailer[/b] yet? BOT.VINNIK insists it qualifies for a Grandmaster title. Watch it below—and if it makes you chuckle or nod in respect, don’t forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the game![/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/58g7isfKb8k"]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy announce trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the support—and for putting up with our electronic mentor.[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the Academy! [/p][p]Rodrigo & Eduardo Deep Green Games[/p]
